blocks.label: Campaign hero
blocks.description: A full-bleed photograph with the headline set over it, on a built-in shade or plate so it reads over any picture. First on a page.

blocks.label: Photo and text
blocks.description: Words beside a photograph on the page's split line (text left, picture right by default); the picture keeps its crop (`ratio`) and is never taller than the screen.

blocks.label: Lookbook grid
blocks.description: Looks from one lookbook in a grid of two to four columns, each linking to its place in the lookbook.

blocks.label: Single look
blocks.description: One look, large, with the pieces it is made of and their prices.

blocks.label: Gallery
blocks.description: Several photographs: one large frame beside four small ones, an even row, or three columns. No captions.

blocks.label: Image band
blocks.description: One photograph across the container, panoramic or wide, at its own crop (4:3 on a phone).

blocks.label: Quote
blocks.description: One quotation set large in italic, with a name and an optional portrait.

blocks.label: Statement
blocks.description: A sentence set large with no picture; with `highlight` its words turn from grey to ink one by one as it crosses the screen.

blocks.label: Pieces
blocks.description: Garments as cards: a still-life photograph, the name, a note, a price as text and a link.

blocks.label: Story
blocks.description: A passage of writing in markdown, in one column or with the heading in the margin; optional drop cap.

blocks.label: Journal stories
blocks.description: The latest journal stories, as covers in a grid or as an index of titles.

blocks.label: Stockists
blocks.description: The shops that carry the label, grouped by town, from src/data/stockists.json.

blocks.label: Ticker
blocks.description: A line of words drifting across the page; CSS only, pausable, still with reduced motion. Use sparingly: never on the home page.

blocks.label: Newsletter
blocks.description: A sign-up form from src/content/forms/ (default: newsletter) beside an optional photograph; sends to the Galley inbox.

blocks.label: Invitation
blocks.description: The closing invitation with one or two buttons, on a colour or beside a photograph.

blocks.label: Contact
blocks.description: Contact details beside a form from src/content/forms/ (default: contact), with an optional photograph; email links open the email-link chooser.

blocks.label: Film
blocks.description: A film's poster frame with a play mark, linking to where the film is hosted; nothing is embedded.

blocks.label: Form
blocks.description: Any form from src/content/forms/ (a stockist enquiry, a fitting request) beside an optional photograph; sends to the Galley inbox.

blocks.label: Chapters
blocks.description: Two to four steps, each with its own photograph; on a wide screen each step's words stay in view while its photograph scrolls past.

blocks.label: Credits
blocks.description: Roles and names, like the credits of a shoot.

templates.label: Campaign page
templates.description: A full-screen campaign photograph with the headline over it, a statement, looks, pieces and an invitation.

templates.label: Lookbook
templates.description: A season's lookbook: cover, looks with their pieces, credits and an invitation to try them on.

templates.label: Feature story
templates.description: An image-led long read: a statement opening, photographs, writing, a quote and a gallery.

templates.label: About / atelier
templates.description: Who makes the clothes and where: a portrait, the story, the workroom, the people.

templates.label: Stockists
templates.description: Where to try the clothes on, grouped by town, with an invitation to order by post.

templates.label: Contact
templates.description: Contact details and a form, with opening hours and directions.
